Ticket T-8014 (owner-approved Swarm Watch clarity pass, last part). The approved project card is on this branch (renderWatchProjectCard in tools/watch-assets/board.js, styles in tools/watch-assets/swarm-ui.css; data: projectOverview(...).card, tests in tests/board-card-ui.test.mjs and tests/board-accuracy-card.test.mjs). Bring the PROJECT PAGE (tools/watch-assets/project.js, data from projectDetail in tools/board-data.mjs) and the OVERVIEW tab (tools/watch-assets/board.js overview tiles and sections) to the same style and words:
PROJECT PAGE: lead with the same head (name, machine, installed version), big percent with bar (same boardPercent; hover 'D of T tickets'), and the same Now / Next / Blocked rows, slots sentence, ETA with hover math, facts row and heads-up sentence, reusing the card's rendering helpers (export them from board.js or move shared pure render helpers into tools/watch-assets/board-lib.js) and the card data (add card to projectDetail by calling the same builder projectOverview uses, so both pages use one function). Clickable counts open the same lists with exact commands and copy buttons. Keep the rest of the page (tickets, runs, lessons, untracked list with id 'untracked') but rename labels to plain words (untracked runs, checkouts, hand-edits blocked by the guard; 'split red' becomes the heads-up sentence). Every number has a label and a title. No money.
OVERVIEW: the KPI tiles use plain words with a title on every number (live agents, workers held etc.); remove any jargon ('off-ledger', 'trees', 'split red'); no money.
TESTS in tests/board-accuracy-page.test.mjs (use tests/helpers/board-accuracy-fixture.mjs): every number on the project page and the overview, rendered in a fake DOM from projectDetail / boardSnapshot over the fixture, equals an oracle computed from the fixture files on disk (ledger, tickets.log, run files, lanes.json, events, git worktree list) and the card on the board shows the same values as the project page for the same project; the old words are absent; every number element has a label and a title. Add a COVERAGE table of displayed fields with a guard test like tests/board-accuracy-card.test.mjs. Stub navigator/clipboard robustly for Node 20 and 22 (see the descriptor-capture pattern in tests/board-card-ui.test.mjs). Do NOT touch tools/swarm.mjs, the tools/swarm folder, package files, .github or server files other than tools/board-data.mjs. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test --test-timeout=60000 tests/board-accuracy-page.test.mjs tests/board-*.test.mjs tests/watch-*.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`.
